We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We have guidance: three steps: 1) amide formation from carboxylic acid + amine (coupling). 2) Doebner modification to form the α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acid (the C=C and carbonyl). 3) sulfonamide formation from amine + sulfonyl chloride.

Thus retrosynthetic direction: target -> break amide bond to give carboxylic acid precursor and aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). Then break the α,β-unsaturated acid to give aromatic aldehyde (maybe) and malonic acid? Doebner modification forward: aldehyde + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated acid. So retro: unsaturated acid -> aldehyde + malonic acid (or its derivative). The unsaturated acid is attached to aromatic ring via /C=C/ to the sulfonyl phenyl. Actually the unsaturated acid is attached to phenyl sulfonyl group: c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2 attached to sulfonyl group. So the unsaturated acid is part of side chain: phenyl-sulfonyl-phenyl-CH=CH-CO-NH-aniline.

Thus step 2: break the C=C double bond and carbonyl to give aromatic aldehyde (maybe p-? The aldehyde would be on the phenyl ring attached to sulfonyl: c2ccc(CHO)cc2. Indeed Doebner modification: aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated acid (aryl-CH=CH-COOH). So our unsaturated acid is aryl-CH=CH-CO-NH-aniline (actually amide). Wait forward: Doebner gives unsaturated acid (aryl-CH=CH-COOH). Then later amide formation attaches aniline to the acid to give aryl-CH=CH-CO-NH-aniline. So retro: break amide to give unsaturated acid (aryl-CH=CH-COOH) and aniline. Then break unsaturated acid to aldehyde + malonic acid.

Thus step 3: sulfonamide formation: the sulfonyl chloride (maybe p-toluenesulfonyl chloride?) Actually we have NS(=O)(=O) attached to a tolyl ring (para-methyl phenyl). The sulfonamide is formed from an amine (the tolyl amine) reacting with sulfonyl chloride derived from p-toluenesulfonyl chloride? Wait the sulfonamide is attached to the tolyl ring: Cc1ccc(N S(=O)(=O) c2ccc(... )cc2)cc1. So the sulfonamide nitrogen is attached to the tolyl ring (an aniline). So retro: break sulfonamide to give p-toluidine (aniline with methyl) and sulfonyl chloride (p-toluenesulfonyl chloride? Actually the sulfonyl chloride would be Cl-S(=O)(=O)-c2ccc(... )cc2). So the sulfonyl chloride is attached to the second phenyl ring (the one bearing the unsaturated amide). So we need to propose that.

Thus overall retrosynthesis:

Target (M0) -> step1 (amide formation) -> precursor A (aryl-CH=CH-COOH attached to sulfonyl phenyl) + aniline (c3ccccc3N). Actually the amide is attached to aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). So precursor after step1: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/COOH)cc2)cc1 (the acid) plus aniline (c3ccccc3N). Wait the amide is C(=O)N attached to aniline. So after breaking amide, we have acid (aryl-CH=CH-COOH) attached to sulfonyl phenyl, and aniline (c3ccccc3N). Good.

Step2: break unsaturated acid to aldehyde + malonic acid. So precursor B: aldehyde on phenyl-sulfonyl phenyl: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(CHO)cc2)cc1 plus malonic acid (HOOC-CH2-COOH). Actually malonic acid is a simple reagent.

Step3: break sulfonamide to give p-toluidine (Cc1ccc(NH2)cc1) and sulfonyl chloride (Cl-S(=O)(=O)-c2ccc(CHO)cc2). So final precursors: p-toluidine, sulfonyl chloride (aryl sulfonyl chloride), aniline, malonic acid.

But we need only 3 reactions, so we can combine steps: Reaction1: sulfonamide formation (retro) to give p-toluidine and sulfonyl chloride (aryl sulfonyl chloride). Reaction2: Doebner modification (retro) to give aldehyde and malonic acid. Reaction3: amide coupling (retro) to give aniline and acid.

Thus we need to produce JSON route with three reaction nodes, each with template IDs. We need to find appropriate template IDs for each transformation.

We can search for sulfonamide formation template (forward: sulfonyl chloride + amine -> sulfonamide). So retro we need to break sulfonamide. Let's search for functional_groups_formed: sulfonamides, broken: amine? Actually forward forms sulfonamide, breaks S-Cl and N-H. So retro: break sulfonamide to sulfonyl chloride and amine. So search with functional_groups_formed ["sulfonamides"] and functional_groups_broken maybe ["alkyl halide"]? The sulfonyl chloride has S-Cl (halide). So broken functional group could be "alkyl halide"? The list includes "alkyl halide". Let's try.
